newsitem.title: QATAR: Sudanese vice-president in Qatar for talks on war.
newsitem.headline: Sudanese vice-president in Qatar for talks on war.

text.p: Sudanese Vice-President al-Zubeir Mohammad Saleh arrived in Qatar on Tuesday as part of a tour of Arab states to brief leaders on the military conflict in Sudan, the official Qatar News Agency (QNA) reported.
Sudan's military government has called for mobilisation against what it says are attacks by troops of neighbours Eritrea and Ethiopia. Both states deny these charges.
Sudanese rebels said they launched the fighting to put pressure on the Khartoum government and bring about a popular uprising.
Rebel leader John Garang said on Tuesday his forces killed 300 government troops in a battle south of the key eastern town of Damazin.
Saleh arrived in Doha from Syria on a swing through the region that has included Saudi Arabia, Egypt and Yemen.
